stemMarkdown: A student scored 100 marks in an exam and failed by 20 marks. If the pass mark is 40% of the maximum marks, what are the maximum marks?
solutionMarkdown: The pass mark is $100 + 20 = 120$. If the maximum is $M$, then $\dfrac{40}{100} \times M = 120$, so $M = \dfrac{120 \times 100}{40} = 300$.
